name: Sylph
desc: Whirling lines of aery luminance, tracing the contours of the wind — mischief and play.

stat.effects:
Active| Gust: Push or pull a Target of up to 10T Bulk toward or away from you, up to 10T Meters. On a collision both suffer Crushing Damage — Vicious for the lighter, Blunted for the heavier; if the stationary Target is half the moving one's Weight or less, it suffers Traumatic instead.
Active| Slip: As a 0_AP Reaction to anything, you Maneuver.
Passive| Body of Air: You gain Reflex up to T.

name: Shir
desc: Geometric and cold, drifting formations of slowly convolving metallic form.

stat.effects:
Passive| Aegis: You conjure a floating Shield usable without a hand, with 3T Durability.
Passive| Damascene: You conjure a blade, spike or hammer within 1 Meter, dealing Crushing, Piercing or Cutting Damage without a hand. At 3T it is Vicious; at 6T you may exchange it for Impaling, Rending or Traumatic Damage.
Active| Magniturgy: Cause two pieces of metal (up to 3T Bulk total) to attract or repel. Attraction requires a DC_(10+T) Vitality/Action Test to overcome; repulsion can cause Crushing Damage from collisions.

name: Gora
desc: Animate stupa of stones balanced at impossible angles, languidly swaying.

stat.effects:
Passive| Body of Earth: You gain Body, up to T.
Active| Stone Speak: Reshape or displace up to 10T of soil, rock or sand (a full Space of stone is ~30-40 Bulk). Harden or soften earth, raising or lowering its Durability by T, or change rock to sand or back, if the real Durability was less than T.
Passive| Dust Release: A storm of whirling dust erupts within 3T Meters, Blinding everything within it.

name: Zori
desc: Born from foam drawn off the crest of waves, always shifting, flowing and crashing upward.

stat.effects:
Passive| River Body: You or a Creature you Touch redistribute their Abilities by up to 2T.
Passive| Glide-Plain: A Target up to 10T Bulk, or Spaces up to 3T, become exempt from friction — continuing in straight lines (ignoring Difficult Terrain) once moving, and unable to start moving without a push.
Active| Moon Holding: Move or displace up to 10T Bulk of liquid water, or change liquid to vapour and back. You can draw about T Bulk of water from humid air per use.

name: Kirin
desc: Resonant shards of pale hue that lodge in the finest jewels, humming softly.

stat.effects:
Active| Barrier: Conjure a translucent Barrier up to T Meters in place — no Weight, Durability_T, nearly any shape.
Passive| Empty Body: You become translucent and Vulnerable_T, but may take T extra Actions while Sneaking with no extra Chaos Dice.
Active| Shatter: The space around a Target within 10T Meters shatters, provoking Minor Panic Risk — Moderate at twice their Tier, Major at four times.

name: Hema
desc: Black-red traceries found wherever ichor is spilled, often in the arc that loosed it.

stat.effects:
Active| Hemollurgy: You or a Target you Touch shed up to T Strain for one Corruption (tripled for Persistent Strain). This also ends the Bleeding Condition.
Passive| Iron Mist: You begin to Bleed; all your Strikes are more Vicious while Bleeding — twice at T3, thrice at T6 — and you reset your Bleed-Out time each time you Injure a Creature.
Passive| Whisper: If this is twice a Target's Tier within 10 Meters, they become Frenzied; while Bleeding they cannot resist the Frenzy and spend all AP.

name: Goro'kar
desc: Solitary beings with ancient, simple wills — boulders that walk.

stat.effects:
Innate| Immutable: When you would suffer an Injury, spend Light equal to the Damage to negate it.
Active| Shell: You gain earthen Armor with 3T Durability for the next Minute.
Active| Stone-Sight: Touch a surface for 0_AP and instantly Spot everything in contact with it within 3T Meters.

name: Talus
desc: Noble Spirits of great intellect — empty, wraithlike figures of fluted armour.

stat.effects:
Innate| Steel-Born Lance: You hold a supernatural Polearm — 1/2_Handed, +1_Accuracy, Piercing, Reach, Light, Durability 6+(Spirit Binding), Bulk 6. Two-handed it gains Reach. Banish or Summon it for 1_AP; add Voltaic Damage for 3 Light; it sheds all Notches each Dawn.
Active| Blue Vengeance: When Struck, spend 3 Light as a 0_AP Reaction to afflict the Attacker with Voltaic Damage — more Light, more Vicious.
Active| Bolt: Spend 1_AP and Light: a Target within 100 Meters touching metal suffers Voltaic Damage. Each extra Light Arcs it to another Target up to 100 Meters on.

name: Harkoi
desc: Lumbering six-legged behemoths of black ever-frost whose white eyes betray deep wisdom.

stat.effects:
Innate| Foundation: You are immune to Frost Damage and Extreme Cold; when you suffer any Energy Damage, spend Light for 0_AP to make it less Vicious, even Blunting it.
Active| White Rime: Touch a Weapon for 1_AP to make it more Vicious and Frost-dealing for T Minutes; the same on Armour or a Shield makes it more durable and grants its bearer Resistance to Energy for T Minutes.
Active| Ice Bind: Conjure black-ice Chains between two Targets within 10 Meters, Linking them at their distance. Chains have 2T Durability, Resistance:2_All (except Incendiary), and are immune to Blunted Damage. Within 100 Meters you may change their length by 3 Meters per AP.

name: Kalhari
desc: Great white spines of bone with gnashing teeth, dwelling in the hearts of clouds.

stat.effects:
Innate| Eigen Vektor: Choose your own down-direction as a 1_AP Movement; halt a fall as a 0_AP Reaction, floating weightless until you restore your down-direction (each halt in a Round costs one more AP).
Active| Cleave: Spend 1_AP and Light: a Target within 10 Meters suffers Blunt Cutting Damage. Spend more than their Tier to lose Blunt; twice their Tier makes it Rending, Vicious for every 2 further Light.
Active| Exaltation: A howling updraft fills 10 Meters for 1 Minute, penalizing Ranged Attacks that pass through by T and reducing all Weight within by thrice that.

name: Bul
desc: Nearly invisible violet currents of power, seen only at the apex of great heights.

stat.effects:
Passive| Un-Weight: A Target you Touch becomes heavier or lighter by T. No Weight floats; negative Weight falls in reverse.
Active| No-Where: A Target weighing no more than 10T treats a direction you choose as down for one Round.
Passive| All-Pit: A Target within 10T Meters becomes the new down-direction for everything within 2T Meters of it.

name: Zao
desc: Circular, halo-like forms rimming candles and torches — geometric and ubiquitous.

stat.effects:
Passive| Starlight: Create a point of white light within 10T Meters, which can be Linked to a Target in Range.
Passive| Exclusion: A Radius up to 3T within 10T Meters fills with Magical Darkness; no light is effective within.
Passive| Unseen Light: You perceive heat with your eyes, out to 10(10T) Meters.

name: Hirar
desc: Shimmering mirages of colour and pain, clinging to the tongues of fire.

stat.effects:
Passive| Inner Fire: You become immune to Extreme Heat or Cold of T or less.
Passive| Flame Tongue: A Weapon you Touch gains Incendiary Damage — more Vicious at Tier 3, twice at Tier 6, and so on.
Active| Lash: A Target within 10T Meters suffers Incendiary Damage if this exceeds their Tier, more Vicious for each multiple.

name: Aza
desc: Flakes white and drifting on the wind's chill, giving a knife edge to mountain gusts.

stat.effects:
Active| White Burn: A Target within 10T Meters suffers Frost Damage if this exceeds their Tier, more Vicious for each multiple.
Active| Breath of Frost: Freeze up to 10T Bulk of liquid water within 10 Meters. Creatures in frozen water are Restrained and begin suffocating if enclosed.
Active| Stasis: Become Restrained and Stunned_6 for Rounds up to T (chosen), gaining Resistance:6_All and 10T Durability Armour. Breaking it or Heat of 3T+ ends the Duration.

name: Howrung
desc: Untamed beasts of wing and claw, eyes burning voltaic blue-white, voices of thunder and joy.

stat.effects:
Innate| Wind Roar: Invoke a Cyclone (no Light) — a Radius up to 6(your Tier) centred on you. Ranged Attacks deflect off its boundary unless they deal more Damage than its Radius; Enemies treat it as Difficult Terrain up to your Tier; leaving it inflicts Frost Damage.
Active| Flash and Bang: Maneuver up to 3T Meters in a straight line; everything between you and your destination suffers Voltaic Damage, and you may pass through Creatures/Objects with Durability lower than your Reflex.
Passive| Atlas Aspect: You know the local Weather T Days ahead. In a natural Storm you gain a Flying Speed twice your Movement, your Cyclone negates all Enemy Ranged Attacks, you are immune to Voltaic Damage and may redirect it within 10T Meters, and may force Lightning to strike you.

name: Nar'gha
desc: Beasts of many arms and sundering footfalls, maned with serpent tails — scions of doom.

stat.effects:
Innate| Quaking Falls: Your Weight is increased by your Body; on a Walking Movement, Creatures you Engage (and within 1 Meter of your end-point) fall Prone if lighter than you. When you take Falling Damage, everything within 3 Meters suffers Blunted Crushing Damage.
Active| Boom: Your voice becomes shockingly loud for 1 Minute. A 0_AP Shout Deafens Creatures within 10T Meters for 1 Round; at twice their Tier they Risk Minor Panic, Moderate at thrice, Major at four times.
Passive| Calamity Grip: Your Encumbrance rises by 3T and you vertically lift as much as you drag (six times Body). A Grabbed Creature used as an Improvised Weapon is Thrown twice as far, and both it and the Target suffer the Damage.

name: Al'Saris
desc: Lethal shapes of purifying fire, galloping the burning plains, setting field and forest ablaze.

stat.effects:
Innate| Contagious Affliction: When anything is destroyed, killed or Injured by Incendiary Damage within 10 Meters, conjure a Spark as a 0_AP Reaction — instantly consumed to deal Blunt Incendiary Damage within 10 Meters of its source. Light can conjure more Sparks.
Active| Crimson Invocation: For T Minutes, light a Space within 10 Meters on Fire for 1_AP (already-burning Targets ignite adjacent Spaces). Fires persist 1 Minute, longer with fuel; ideal fuel spreads naturally.
Passive| Pyrebug: Allies within T Meters gain half your Resistance to Incendiary Damage.

name: Sammarin
desc: Palatial stretches of green and rooting wilds — equal parts grove and Spirit of Vital principle.

stat.effects:
Innate| The Green Speech: Plants flourish and animals grow well in your presence, and the air is cleansed. All Beasts and plants understand you and will hear your cause — you might turn an invasive species away, double crop growth, or ward Beasts from pastures.
Active| Holly-Fingers: For 1_AP, all plants within 10 Meters become your Touch for T Minutes, doing anything your hands could (including wielding a Weapon). If none are present, they spring into being and remain if possible.
Active| Root Nexus: All trees and tree-like plants count as one Space for you and can be stepped into. Inside, you perceive where you entered and may exit from another, up to 10T Kilometers away.

name: Kul
desc: Pale aspects, shimmering folds of ice-white silk veiling nothing — solemn embodiments of the End.

stat.effects:
Innate| Memoria: You perceive the Echoes of the dead — they confess the manner of their death and their killers. Pursuing an Echo's just cause, you spend no Light for Powers below Tier 3.
Passive| The Shield of the Weak: A Radius up to 6T (no Action). Within, you may transfer any Damage from its Target to yourself; if that Target is a lower Tier than you, the Damage is Blunted.
Active| I Remain: When you would be Injured, spend Light equal to the amount to Blunt it.

name: Seit
desc: Invisible chimes of timbral resonance, following those things fated to shape the future.

stat.effects:
Active| Unfolding: Touching an Object, you remember its "life" from up to T(T) Days ago — an intuition of who used it and why, and anything of great import within that time.
Passive| Slipping: As a 0_AP Reaction, gain an additional AP for 1 Light and 2 Strain.
Active| Halt: Invoked at thrice a Target's Tier within 10 Meters, they are Frozen in time — unmovable, undamageable and unable to be meaningfully interacted with.

name: Kunar
desc: Thoughtful, diminutive beings the colour of cobweb and mist, attentive to the depths of time.

stat.effects:
Innate| Repetition: Within 6 Seconds you may re-do your Turn, resetting everything to that point, suffering 3 Strain each time. Re-doing the same Turn twice Incapacitates you at its end.
Active| Imposition: Invoked at thrice a Target's Tier, you force them to re-do their Turn (you still suffer the Strain and possible Incapacitation). They are unaware it happened.
Active| Open the Eyes of Memory: Perceive the present location as it was up to T(10T) Days ago. You may remain in this frozen moment as long as you like, but cannot move or turn your head; Creatures do not appear.

name: Zei'ken
desc: White and papery like birch bark, Spirits of few words that carry monstrous import.

stat.effects:
Innate| Foresight: Preempting a Creature always succeeds, but you gain only 1_AP. Without the AP, or after your Turn, spend Light equal to thrice the Target's Tier to Preempt them.
Active| Denial: When a Creature acts, Invoke at twice their Tier and make a Binding Test, DC_(10 + thrice their Tier), to prevent them — they keep the AP for other Actions.
Active| Doom: Ascertain whether an event will or will not happen within T Days. Doomed events always occur; Fates are chosen by the GM. Abusing this Power Frustrates your Bond.

name: Ghara
desc: Wheals of violet and black crawling over the dead and decaying, carrying a strangely pleasant odour.

stat.effects:
Active| Reduction: A Creature within 10 Meters suffers T Strain; corpses and dead plantlife rapidly degenerate.
Active| Adaptation: When you would be Injured, spend Light equal to the Damage and suffer twice as much Standard Strain instead.
Active| Communion: Touching two Targets, spend Light equal to their Tiers to transfer a Disease from one to the other.

name: Khoi
desc: Furling shoots of vibrant green and white, drifting motes of floral radiance — restoration and growth.

stat.effects:
Active| Benisson: A Creature you Touch sheds an Injury for a Light cost by Severity — Minor 20, Moderate 60, Major 200.
Active| Calm: A Creature you Touch rolls one fewer Chaos Die for a Disease for T Days.
Passive| Green Light: For 1_AP and Light, a 3T-Meter Radius around you stops all Bleeding and rolls Injury Risk with a Boon.

name: Cervine
desc: Hulking creatures of bark and horn, vanguards of forest and beast, terrible but rare in wrath.

stat.effects:
Innate| Green Sight: Detect life nearby — within 10 Meters, a Vision that pierces all Cover; within 100 Meters, an intuitive count of Creatures.
Passive| Arbor Offering: A Beast you Touch becomes your Ally if Invoked at thrice its Tier. Harming it, or commanding it to harm an ally, breaks this and Frustrates your Bond.
Active| Forest Dreaming: In a natural environment, instantly know its geometry, dangers, flora, fauna and the Creatures within, especially any seen before, up to 10T Kilometers.

name: Koi'Zin
desc: Carapaced in vibrant hues with a hundred ebony eyes, territorial guards of the waters below.

stat.effects:
Innate| Sea King's Armor: You are always clad in chitin — Armour of Bulk 10 and Durability up to 6+(Spirit Binding) — which removes Blunt from your Unarmed Attacks. It sheds Notches on Rest, or spend Light (2 per Notch, no Action). It prevents benefiting from other Armour.
Active| Snap: On an Unarmed Strike, spend two Light to make it more Vicious, or six Light to change its Type to Traumatic.
Active| Water God's Blessing: A Creature you Touch may Hold their Breath passively for the next T Hours.

name: K'Sith
desc: Green and yellow as grass and leaf, great in size — a watcher that knows all the forms of beasts.

stat.effects:
Innate| Skin Changing: Adopt the shape of any Beast you Touch as a 10_AP Primary Action, gaining its Size, Weight, Speeds and Senses; your Body and Reflex are set to theirs. Spend Light (thrice its Tier) to reduce the cost to 1_AP, and three more to make it a Reaction.
Passive| Remember Me: After ten Minutes' ritual with an allied Beast, spend Light (thrice its Tier) to Mark it. Marked Beasts share your aura against predation, you always know where they are, and you may Skin Change into them without Touch.
Active| Serpent Blessing: A Creature you Touch gains your aura and may speak with and understand Beasts for T Days.

name: Hyrkath
desc: Wrathful forms, fierce and swift aloft — deadly foes promising an end to trespassers.

stat.effects:
Innate| Talon Aspect: Manifest a Stinger from your body — Unarmed Strikes with it are Melee, +1_Accuracy, Piercing, and dose Injured Targets with Hyrkath Venom (Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly 6; the Target is Off_Balance and Risks Minor Panic from pain each Round they spend more than 1 AP; Overdose: Incapacitated).
Passive| Drone Song: You gain membranous Wings — a Flying Speed of T+(your Movement). They are impacted by Injuries whether Invoked or not.
Passive| Reading the Wind: Your smell amplifies, identifying nearly any substance and known individuals within 10T Meters.

name: Klesh
desc: Enormous arachnids, fast and lethal venomous hunters that spring from the shadows.

stat.effects:
Innate| Weaver's Aspect: Produce Webbing at will — Mundane or Adhesive (sticking to and Linking whatever it touches). Webbing has Durability 6, Weak:3_Incendiary, and takes shapes from nets to ropes; a Strand between two things Links them at its distance. It substitutes for Fiber in making, adding 3 Durability but the Incendiary Weakness.
Active| Nine Eyes: For T Minutes, Sneaking against you rolls twice the Chaos Dice and you roll Luminance with a Boon; you may Leap up to your Movement and gain a Climbing Speed up to your Movement on any surface your Webbing could stick to.
Passive| Soft Aspect: If you take no Movement for one Round, you gain Soft Cover. Attacking a Creature that cannot Detect you, you gain +T and the Damage is more Vicious by one.

name: Oolupsil
desc: Light forms of shifting fronds, part of a fungal network spanning kilometers under the forest floor.

stat.effects:
Innate| Proliferation: Touch a Creature to implant one Spore, lasting Days equal to your Training. You sense where your Spores are, whose they are, and that Creature's condition and emotion; you may First-Aid a Spored Creature at any Distance, or spend 1_AP to make them Off-Balance, and treat them as your own Space for Invoking Powers.
Active| Rooting: Conjure up to T Spaces of edible Mushrooms within 10 Meters (Durability 3, any flavour, no nutrition unless cultivated a Month). Extra Light adds 3 Durability each.
Active| Mycelia: Invoked at thrice a Target's Tier, leave a Tiny Permanent Spore with a Touch — a Magical Effect vulnerable to Negation but otherwise self-sustaining.

name: Lami
desc: Motes of yellow-white, drops of liquid dreams and wishes, appearing in joy and in despair.

stat.effects:
Passive| Starlight: White light floods from your eyes in a Radius up to 10T. Allies in it roll Panic Risk with one fewer Chaos Die.
Active| Fortune: Touch a Creature and spend Light to grant a Boon usable on any Test in the next T Hours.
Active| Glory: Spend all remaining Light: gain 3 AP and a Turn immune to all Strain and Injuries, using any Power up to twice your Training without spending Light. When the Turn ends, your body evaporates into white sparks, vanishing forever.

name: Aletha
desc: Electric motions and twists of light — concentric vibrating rings of ascending inward spirals.

stat.effects:
Active| Quicken: For 3 Light, gain one AP.
Active| Jinx: When a Creature makes a Test, spend Light equal to twice their Tier to inflict a Bane.
Active| Skip: As a 1_AP Movement, instantly translate up to 3T Meters in any direction without Provoking Attacks — you cannot pass obstacles, nor actually cross the in-between space.

name: Kuen'in
desc: A flicker in the look, a taste on the tongue — pepper, sugar and bitter roots.

stat.effects:
Passive| Lure: You radiate an aura that heightens colours, smells and impressions, raising the Disposition of any Creature whose Tier is less than T.
Active| Loss: When a Creature fails a Test, spend Light equal to their Tier to inflict Strain up to the amount they missed the DC by.
Active| Distance: Enchant an Object or Creature you Touch — all Tests made with, using or Targeting it are harder by one for T Hours.

name: Kars'the
desc: A gaze from the Outside, looking in — never itself seen, always felt.

stat.effects:
Passive| False-Light: Up to T Spaces fill with a static illusion of anything you imagine — visual, auditory, satisfying all senses but touch.
Active| Thievery: Take the look of someone you Touch for 10T Minutes. If you are the same kind and size, the illusion is perfect; otherwise a Touch reveals it as false.
Passive| Open: You pierce Objects with your Vision, so long as their Durability is less than 3T.

name: Si'en
desc: Intensely primitive, yellow points of fire burning up the nerves — unbidden weakness, invoked a weird strength.

stat.effects:
Active| Paranoia: Seal another Power to a drawn sigil (ten Minutes' work, twice its Light), with a condition for its use. Released, the Seal is treated as your location; Sealed Passives don't count against your maximum but are destroyed with the Seal.
Passive| Ward: Ten Minutes' work conjures a circle that forbids supernatural beings of your choice — to affect a Creature it must be Invoked at thrice their Tier.
Active| Banish: Target a Magical Effect; Invoked at thrice its Tier or more, it ends instantly. Some intrinsically Magical Effects resist, only temporarily losing power.

name: Dadak
desc: Crimson sparks that erase everything defective and faltering — something new, something worse.

stat.effects:
Active| Red World: Become Frenzied for T Minutes (cannot End). While Frenzied you gain +1 to all Abilities, +T Initiative, and may accept a Bane to an Attack to make it more Vicious by your Tier — but you are Weak to all Damage equal to your Tier.
Active| Tracer: When you Attack with a Weapon, for 1_AP echo its Damage, Blunted, against any Target within T Meters. Tracers cannot miss.
Active| Leo Sard: Touch a Weapon for 1_AP: it gains T Reach; beyond thrice its normal Reach, its Damage is Blunted.

name: Anag'ke
desc: Something never there — because when it is, you won't have felt it. Impulses baser than fright.

stat.effects:
Passive| Enchaining: Touch a Creature for 1_AP and Light equal to ten times their Tier: they lose access to their Magical capacities for the Duration.
Active| Empty Recollection: Touch a Creature for 1_AP: they forget something from the last T Hours.
Active| Eye Bite: Target a Creature within 10 Meters and spend Light equal to thrice their Tier: they are Blinded for T Minutes.

name: Uilo
desc: A hundredfold of eyes, each seeing another face, whose wings overshadow but bring no darkness.

stat.effects:
Innate| Sleepwalking: While asleep, walk the Dreamworld and visit the sleep of any whose Name you know. There, whoever has the higher Mind controls it almost omnipotently; an Injury there negates that night's Rest.
Active| Ephemera: Translate something from the Dreamworld into reality within 10 Meters for 1 Minute — an Object up to 10T Bulk, or a Creature of Tier less than half your Training (Light equal to twice its Tier). Conjured Creatures are Mindless Chaff acting after your Turn.
Passive| Dream Warrior: Conjure Weapons from the Dreamworld for 1_AP — a replica of any Weapon you know or invent. They vanish when released (Thrown/Shot Weapons still land first), cannot inflict Lethal Injuries (auto-Blunting such rolls), and have Durability T.

name: Akhlysine
desc: Formed like a Vogul, a mask showing nothing but a crooked grin — a mocking force of the lower Realms.

stat.effects:
Innate| Sleep Talking: When you Intimidate, spend Light for an equal Bonus. A Critical Success compels those weaker than you to join your side, for now.
Active| Eclipse: As a Reaction to a Creature Panicking, spend Light equal to twice their Tier to instantly Incapacitate them.
Active| Hell Light: Conjure a Fell-star — a point of violet-red light. Every Creature within 3T Meters that fails a Test Risks Minor Panic; Critical Failures Risk Major Panic.

name: Seele
desc: Tall dwellers of the Nightworld, whose forests admit no sun — they watch, betraying nothing.

stat.effects:
Innate| Steps in the Night: Become Invisible at will with a 0!_AP Action, gaining Soft Cover; while Invisible you cannot speak and are Deafened.
Passive| Soft Veil: Your hearing pierces Soft Cover as if by sight within 10T Meters.
Active| Revelation: A Creature you Touch shares your Senses for T Hours.

name: Istarsis
desc: Gleaming lords of the morning in great houses of song and beauty — almost their own People.

stat.effects:
Innate| Aura of Grace: Allies within 10 Meters treat their Reserve as greater by one, and all Creatures have a better Disposition for you by one within that Radius.
Active| Heroic Act: On a Test, spend Light for a Bonus equal to half the amount. Succeeding by 10 or more Critically Succeeds.
Passive| Sunlight: You radiate soft yellow light within 10 Meters, Blinding Enemies whose Mind is less than your Mind plus this Power's Tier.

name: Inuridan
desc: Almost mistaken for cloaked men or women of shimmering dusk, walking among the People, faceless but seeing.

stat.effects:
Innate| Circle Walking: Slip into or out of Meerh on a Movement Action. Within Meerh you are translucent (roll Stealth as if always Dark) and gain Resistance:1_Physical; you may add Order or Chaos to any Weapon Damage, but suffer Weakness:3_Energy until you return.
Active| Casting: Translate a Creature you Touch to or from Meerh, conferring the same effects for T Minutes. Spirits suffer Weakness:3_Physical when forced fully physical.
Passive| Eyes on the Inside: Perceive Meerh always, without stepping there — seeing Spiritual omens, the scars of crimes and tragedies, and the light of strong emotion.

name: Hao
desc: An empty thing, a nameless Name beyond the circumference of the world, yet part of its order.

stat.effects:
Innate| The Emptiness of all Names: You may act as if Bonded to any Spirit whose Name you know, for Enchantments and Rites — but must still supply any demands they make.
Passive| Speaking without Speaking: After witnessing a Power, you gain it, Invocable at half its Tier (minimum one); each use counts as a unique Passive. One sighting suffices.
Active| Want of Nothing: Become immune to Magical Effects of Tier equal to or lower than your Training for T Minutes.
